purpose: Exercise the existing image path on native Windows, including source evidence and real CLI/SDK transports.
cases: All eight existing image cases; retain all original expected values, conflicts, rejections and evidence checks.
arms: Same Windows runtime with the existing optional preparation profile
manual_intervention: One predeclared 90-degree clockwise correction; no trial angles or field-based transform selection.

runtime.acquisition: Verified upstream release asset SHA-256; extracted selected runtime files with existing 7-Zip. Installer not executed; no registry/global PATH installation.
runtime.authenticode_limit: Get-AuthenticodeSignature returned UnknownError with a certificate time-validity error. This is retained, not treated as valid production signing.

execution.expected_image_requests: 8 default + 8 prepared + 1 CLI + 4 successful SDK + 2 malformed SDK inputs
execution.retries: No automatic reruns after an observation failure; retain the failed receipt and diagnose before any changed execution. Existing time/output limits remain.

acceptance: Inspect every returned candidate, unresolved field, original hash and original-coordinate evidence using the existing checks.
Keep all values unconfirmed and automatic calculation disabled.
Record missing/unexpected fields, conflicts, parser errors, source preservation and cleanup.
Run malformed-input rejection then valid requests on the same actual SDK connection.
Separate native Windows results from earlier WSL/version observations; do not infer platform-caused quality differences.
If product changes are needed, freeze failing contracts first, keep original observations and complete the required regression suite.
cost: No cloud/paid API calls. Hardware, energy and operator cost are not measured and remain unknown.
non_goals: New live Hermes or model campaign
